# GridStack

Responsive drag-and-drop dashboard grid layout for widget-style pages.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="vendor/gridstack/gridstack.min.css">
<script src="vendor/gridstack/gridstack-all.js"></script>
```

The CSS is required for grid positioning; `gridstack-all.js` exposes the global
`GridStack`. MIT licensed — see `LICENSE` and `UPSTREAM.md`.
